content.short: Accept 300+ cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments, a non-custodial gateway that pays straight into the merchant's wallet.
content.description: NOWPayments supports one of the longest lists of coins among payment processors. Merchants add it through e-commerce plugins, hosted checkout pages, invoices, donation widgets or the API, and payments settle directly to the merchant's own wallet. Optional auto-conversion lets businesses receive stablecoins or another asset, whichever coin the customer used. It also offers subscriptions, a point-of-sale tool, white-label checkout and zero-fee mass payouts powered by ChangeNOW, with ready-made setups for e-commerce, gaming, SaaS and payroll.
content.meta: Non-custodial gateway for accepting 300+ cryptocurrencies through plugins, invoices or an API. Explore NOWPayments on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
